properties.displayName: Deny resources outside the allowed locations
properties.description: Region allowlist, modelled on Azure's built-in 'Allowed locations' policy. Region-scoped resources deployed outside the list are denied; resource groups and subscriptions are exempt here because they are global containers, not region-scoped data, and a resource group pinned to a disallowed region would block deploying the exemption itself. Microsoft Entra ID resources are exempt because they are tenant-wide, not region-scoped.

metadata.description: Start with Audit, move to Deny once the compliance report is clean.
The list of locations resources may be deployed to, e.g. westeurope, northeurope.
